steps.label: Run Business Verification
steps.why: Amir Demo reads business name, secretary of state status, domestic registration standing, people verification, watchlist screening. Business Verification adds the checks it doesn't: registered in submitted state, entity type, office address, mail deliverability, property type and 2 more.

steps.label: Retrieve Articles of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing from Utah
steps.why: The Utah domestic filing is inactive (expired) and it records a corporation, while the customer submitted an LLC. The Articles of Incorporation and a Certificate of Good Standing would settle which entity this is and whether it is in good standing. Utah publishes both, so the document agent can fetch them.
